# Project Meru

> Project Meru is an open-source software initiative and GitHub Pages hub for multiple projects.
> **Sumeru** is the first live product: a modular ERP framework in Go (pre-alpha — not for production).

- Hub: https://projectmeru.github.io/
- Sumeru: https://projectmeru.github.io/sumeru/
- Docs: https://projectmeru.github.io/sumeru/docs/
- GitHub: https://github.com/ProjectMeru

## Naming

- **Project Meru**: the organisation, this hub, and the initiative.
- **Sumeru**: the ERP product. In code, CLI, config, and Go modules the name is always `sumeru`.

## Projects on this site

- **Sumeru** — live, pre-alpha. ERP in Go with PostgreSQL and addon modules.
- **Tooling** — planned. Developer utilities.
- **Infra** — planned. Infrastructure-oriented projects.

## Sumeru — key facts

- **Runtime:** Go 1.26+, PostgreSQL. Node.js builds SWC client bundles locally (`make setup` in `sumeru_custom_addons`).
- **Repositories:** `sumeru` (core), `sumeru_addons` (standard business apps), `sumeru_custom_addons` (workspace you run).
- **Models:** `sdk.Model` structs with `sumeru` struct tags; `make generate` writes `models/zmodels.go`. Runtime records are maps.
- **UI:** SWC workspace client (list, form, kanban, graph, pivot, calendar, gantt, map, cohort). Collection control bar with saved searches.
- **API:** JSON-RPC at `POST /api/rpc` (session or API key).
- **Isolation:** one server, one database; multi-company supported; not multi-tenant.
- **Licence:** dual licensed. Community edition Apache 2.0; enterprise edition commercial (not yet available).
